item.title: Parish-wide burn ban remains in effect for Natchitoches Parish
item.description: A parish-wide burn ban remains in effect as of Jan. 4 for all unincorporated areas of Natchitoches Parish due to extremely dry conditions and a heightened risk of wildfires. The declaration was issued by Parish President John Salter on December 29, 2025. item.title: NRMC welcomes first baby of 2026
item.description: Natchitoches Regional Medical Center welcomed the first baby of the New Year on January 1, 2026. Ja’Toria Shepherd gave birth to a baby girl, Ah’Lani, at 10:29 a.m., marking the hospital’s first delivery of 2026. item.description: Louisiana State Police Troop E responded to a one-vehicle crash on Jan. 1 around 1:11 am on I-49 north of Natchitoches.
